messages:
mira: quickheads 917 I'm shrinking the 'welcome-hello' quickstart to fit the signup carousel. goal: one auth line, curl + node + python micro-examples, deploy button, and a two-line troubleshooting tip. draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/599

jon.p: love the mini flow. a couple of tiny asks: 1) use REDWOOD_API_KEY env var (we standardized on that) 2) bump node examples to 20 3) keep responses compact JSON so they render inline

mira: switched to REDWOOD_API_KEY, node:20, trimmed responses to {"id":"r_1","output":"Hi"}. added curl/node/py snippets.

abby.docs: please add a one-line token-scope callout (generation vs embeddings) and a CORS pointer for browser tryouts (one sentence). avoid long prose in quickstarts.

mira: added both: "Use a generation-scoped token for generator endpoints; embedding tokens differ." and "Browser demos require a proxy or hosted playground to protect tokens; see Security guide."

jon.p: deploy badge uses old query format; switch to /deploy?repo=org/repo and update the example response to a single-line JSON. also add tiny FAQ for 401s (one export line).

mira: updated badge to /deploy?repo=redwood-inference/welcome-hello and added FAQ:
```
# 401? ensure env var set:
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_xxx
# windows: set REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_xxx
```

link-bot: linkcheck: broken link found -> /docs/old-deploy-guide.html (404)

mira: replaced with /docs/deploy/buttons and pushed.

ci-bot: mdx-compile & lint pass for PR #599. one remaining check: linkcheck in progress. :white_check_mark:

staging-bot: staging deploy queued for docs after merge.

jon.p: small editorial nit: use "deploy button" language (not "one-click") so copy stays consistent.

mira: changed wording to "deploy button" everywhere, squashed commits, and will merge after linkcheck green. thanks all! :rocket:
